name: atm_selflock_lq1882_20261111
comment: ANCHOR: ATM_SELFLOCK_LQ1882_20261111 — the ATM cycle must adopt the cron wrapper's lock instead of
re-acquiring the same flock through its inherited fd (770 'cycle skipped' lines, last_evaluated_at
frozen at 2026-10-23), and its grade must come from the DB heartbeat plus same-run decision rows,
never from log mtime: a skip-only log is FAILED, a state that has not advanced is FAILED.
Two execution paths share /tmp/tradeai_atm.lock by design (the */15 scheduled lane and the immediate
trigger from proposal_enrichment_loop); they must not share one lane id. The trigger names itself
atm-auto-approver-immediate (TRADEAI_SAFEFLOCK_COMPONENT + TRADEAI_ATM_LANE_ID), keeps its own journal
rows, output log and receipt, and can never overwrite the scheduled lane's receipt or regrade it.
